content.title: Coachella 2026 rocks Indio: See scenes from Weekend 1
content.text: By Karla Rendon • Published April 11, 2026 • Updated on April 13, 2026 at 6:35 pm Music lovers flocked to the low desert by the thousands over the weekend for the 2026 Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival. Headliners for the highly anticipated event included pop star Sabrina Carpenter, pop star Justin Bieber and Colombian singer Karol G. This year's festival boasted several genres ranging from hardcore, to EDM, to R&B and more.
